_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Gavel のパスポートを入手する

Acquiring Credentials#001.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: 申し訳ありませんが、新しいパスポートを発行するわけにはいきません… 承認が必要で―…
Acquiring Credentials#001.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: でも、パスポートを盗まれたんです！{~} 分もしないうちに {p} 行きの便が出るんです。どうしても急いで…
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: 新しいのをどこでもらうかは、もう言いましたよ。次の方どうぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: ふむ… {u} さんですね？残念ながら、人間は Wynn でパスポートを取得する決まりです。
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: お力にはなれません。次の方どうぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: ちょっと、あなた！そう、あなた！外へ来てくれます？助け合えそうなんです。
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: 係官との話が聞こえちゃって… あなたもパスポートを探してるんですよね？
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: Well...so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: それで… 空軍基地に秘密の闇市が隠れてるって噂を聞いたんです。
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Let's explore the airbase, then! We need to look for clues, lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Cinfras Citizen 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: 違法な品を取引してるらしくて… パスポートを買う方法もきっとあるはずです！
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: 協力すれば、入る方法が見つかるかも。どう思います？
Acquiring Credentials#011.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: 空軍基地を探索して闇市の手がかりを探す。

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: あ、宿屋に来たんですね！うーん、ここのバーテンは長く働いてますから…
Acquiring Credentials#013.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know...all, uh...sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: 闇市のことを何か知ってるかも！聞いてみます、ほら… こう、えっと… こっそりと。
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: I can't believe this place! They only have some rancid wheat stored here, what am I supposed to do with that? I'll take a carrot any day over... wheat.
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: All those other airship men carry around those vile face fruits, but I have to say, I've always had a soft spot for potatoes.
Acquiring Credentials#016.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: I wish my airship was black, I can't say I'm a fan of that white palette...
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#019.src: You know, maybe white isn't so bad after all.
Acquiring Credentials#019.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: It turns out, white's actually quite a nice colour.
Acquiring Credentials#020.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#021.src: ... Oh, fine, wheat's not bad. I'll take some, I guess.
Acquiring Credentials#021.speaker:
Airship Commander
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#023.src: Though, really, the face doesn't mean it has to be evil, does it? It could be a nice face, after all.

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: すみません… あの、えっと… このへんで、すごーく安いお店、ご存じないですよね？
Acquiring Credentials#024.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: 宴の卓は整った。スタウトかビールか、どちらにする？
Acquiring Credentials#025.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#027.dst: うまくいった？入れてくれるかな？
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: そう簡単に入り口は見つかりませんよね… {u}、この手がかりでどこへ行けると思います？
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: 探索を続けましょう。案内して。
Acquiring Credentials#029.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#030.dst: 引き続き空軍基地を探索し、闇市の手がかりを探す。

Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: レストラン… なるほど！
Acquiring Credentials#031.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#032.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#032.dst: ねえ、えっと… この人たち、怪しく見えません？
Acquiring Credentials#032.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: 飛空艇の指揮官は、憎むものを愛する。
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#034.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#034.dst: 何かつかめてきた気がします！先へ進みましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#034.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: 手がかりを追う：飛空艇の指揮官は、憎むものを愛する。

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Hmmm... these crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: うーん… この木箱、品物でいっぱいです。いくつか指揮官に渡してみましょうか？
Acquiring Credentials#036.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#037.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#037.dst: 一度裂ければ、二度と戻らぬ。
Acquiring Credentials#037.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#038.dst: よし、先へ進みましょう！この手がかりでどこへ？
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#039.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#039.dst: 手がかりを追う：一度裂ければ、二度と戻らぬ。

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: あの足場の上にいるのは誰？！
Acquiring Credentials#040.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#041.dst: お前ら二人、このためにずいぶん遠くまで来たもんだな？
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market just with that.
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: さて、スタウトとビールの答えは教えてやれる！だが、それだけじゃ闇市には入れないぜ。
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: いいか、闇市に入るには売り物が要る！それも、このへんで気軽に買えるような代物じゃない、分かるだろ。
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.dst: 何か… 違法なものが要る、と？
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#045.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#045.dst: その通り！運がいいな、今日の俺は機嫌がいい。近くに飛空艇が停まってる。そいつを拝借して、品物を手に入れる手伝いをしてやる。
Acquiring Credentials#045.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: えっと… どう思います、{u}？どうしてもパスポートが要るんです、それに… あなたにも得があるでしょう？
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
Acquiring Credentials#047.speaker:
Mechanic
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

similar.text: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!

Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: …分かりました、やりましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#049.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#049.dst: よし！ついて来い、すぐそこだ。
Acquiring Credentials#049.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#051.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#051.dst: 待て！飛空艇を守る衛兵がいる。見つかるなよ！
Acquiring Credentials#051.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: 端の近くにいる… 突き落とせ。
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#053.dst: あー… きっと無事さ、そんなに高くなかったはず…
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: さて、中に入るにはそこしかない！この先にも衛兵がいる。見つからずに片付ければ、もう安心だ！
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: よくやった！飛空艇に乗るぞ。
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#056.dst: 今… 全員突き落としたんですか…？
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#057.dst: しっかりつかまれ！{p} へ向かう。そこで仔竜の卵を集めて、闇市で売れるようにしてやる！
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: 整備士と Doan と共に {p} へ行き、仔竜の卵を手に入れる。

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: 向かう島には仔竜の巣がある！たどり着くのが難しい場所だから、そこで卵を産むんだ。
Acquiring Credentials#059.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#060.dst: それって闇市ですごい値がつくんですよね…？
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: もちろんさ！仔竜の卵は珍しいし、あの島は飛空艇でしか行けない… Letvus じゃひと財産になる。
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: お、見えた！ここから島が見える、つかまってろ。卵を盗みに行くぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: あれは何？！あ… 先客がいるみたいです…
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: くそ、スカイレイダーが来てる！卵を持ち逃げさせるわけにはいかない…
Acquiring Credentials#064.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: よし、そういうことなら、やることは一つだ！さあ、ついて来い！
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: こんなに海賊がいちゃ巣にたどり着けない、倒せ！
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: よし、ついて来い！卵を採りに行くぞ！
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: 卵を採る間、俺を守ってくれ、人間！
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: 半分まで来た、そのまま守ってくれ！
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: よし採れた！飛空艇に戻るぞ、走れ！
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: 兵士、当てさせるな！飛空艇に当たる前に、武器で砲弾を攻撃して弾き返せ！
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#073.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#073.dst: これ以上は砲撃に耐えられねえ… 時間の無駄だ、ずらかるぞ！もっと大きな獲物がある！
Acquiring Credentials#073.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: 危なかった… よし、空軍基地に戻ろう！
Acquiring Credentials#074.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: Doan と共に Blackbird Inn の酒場に戻る。

Acquiring Credentials#076.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#076.dst: お前ら二人、今日は確かに実力を示したな！
Acquiring Credentials#076.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: だから、闇市に入る合言葉を教えてやる。
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: 宿屋のバーテンのところへ戻って、こう言え。「喉は渇いてない、いつも瓶を持ち歩いてる」。
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: それで入る機会が得られるはずだ。幸運を！
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: 助けてくれてありがとうございます… じゃあ、酒場に戻りましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: また来ましたね。バーテンに話しかけましょう。
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: あの、すみません？喉は渇いてません、いつも瓶を持ち歩いてるので。
Acquiring Credentials#082.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: ...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!

Acquiring Credentials#085.src: A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
Acquiring Credentials#085.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 300 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
Acquiring Credentials#086.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
Acquiring Credentials#087.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
Acquiring Credentials#088.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 150 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker:
Black Market Merchant
[Bid Increase: 300 Emeralds]

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.

Acquiring Credentials#092.src: Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.

Acquiring Credentials#093.src: Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
Acquiring Credentials#093.speaker:
Doan
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Acquiring Credentials#095.src: He appears to be rummaging through his documents.

Acquiring Credentials#096.src: We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!

Acquiring Credentials#097.src: You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.

Acquiring Credentials#098.src: Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!

Acquiring Credentials#099.src: I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.

Acquiring Credentials#101.src: ...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?

Acquiring Credentials#102.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#102.dst: 廊下の突き当たりにいる闇市の者とだけ話せ。他の誰とも口をきくな。
Acquiring Credentials#102.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#104.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#104.dst: 闇市に入り、廊下の突き当たりにいるメンバーと話す。

Acquiring Credentials#105.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#105.dst: スカイレイダーから卵を盗んだそうだな。大胆な真似を！
Acquiring Credentials#105.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#107.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#107.dst: パスポート二つ？ざっと {~} エメラルドだな。この卵を市場で売れば手に入る。
Acquiring Credentials#107.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#108.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#108.dst: 市場の仕組みを教えよう。卵の最初の値は安い。商人を回って、もっと高い値をつけてもらうんだ。
Acquiring Credentials#108.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#109.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#109.dst: ただし気をつけろ、値上げを頼めるのは {~} 回までだ。
Acquiring Credentials#109.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#110.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#110.dst: いろんな商人と話して、それぞれが卵の値をどれだけ上げるか見てみるといい。
Acquiring Credentials#110.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#111.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#111.dst: 幸運を。死なないようにな。
Acquiring Credentials#111.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#112.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#112.dst: 商人と話し、パスポートを買うための {~} エメラルドを集める。

Acquiring Credentials#113.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#113.dst: {u}、それで足ります。売った！卵はあなたのものです。
Acquiring Credentials#113.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#114.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#114.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#116.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.
Acquiring Credentials#116.dst: もう一度闇市のメンバーと話す。

Acquiring Credentials#117.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#117.dst: で、エメラルドは持ってきたか？
Acquiring Credentials#117.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#118.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#118.dst: ふむ… これで足りる。ほら、パスポートだ。
Acquiring Credentials#118.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#119.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#119.dst: あれ… {u}、パスポート落としましたよ。拾ってあげ―…
Acquiring Credentials#119.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#120.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#120.dst: 待って… それ「僕の」パスポート？！ずっとポケットに入ってた…
Acquiring Credentials#120.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#121.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#121.dst: えっと、あの… じゃあ、このエメラルド少し分けてあげます…
Acquiring Credentials#121.speaker: Doan
